prompt:
We're building a legal document management platform. We need a new 'Document' entity added to the server's database layer. Each document has a title, content body, a case number, and belongs to one Author (we already have that entity). Documents can be tagged with multiple Tags (that entity also exists already) — and a single Tag can be applied to many Documents. The platform also needs fast full-text search across document content.

Please scaffold all the necessary server-side persistence files for the Document entity, including the data model itself, all required database migrations (table creation for documents AND for the document-tag relationship), seed data, and the unit tests for the fields. Also make sure the migrations are properly registered in `database.swift`.
